sahneler.metin: An airliner caught fire soon after leaving Riyadh and turned back.
It landed safely, yet all three hundred one people aboard died.
Smoke came from a fire in the rear cargo hold.
The crew returned slowly and took time to stop.
After landing, the jet taxied off the runway.
Smoke and fire filled the cabin before rescuers got in.
Airlines now stress immediate evacuation when fire is present.

aciklama:
Saudia 163 landed after a cargo fire, but no one escaped. The cause: cabin fire and smoke with evacuation never started after landing.
